about: Long descriptions, and more candidates than fit. Scripted input for a capture, not hands-on.

steps.say: ECHO A HOLDS 9 CANDIDATES; 3 WAIT BELOW THE VIEW
DOWN x8 -- THE DRAWER KEEPS THE WHOLE OPEN CARD IN VIEW, AND COUNTS WHAT IS ABOVE AND BELOW
THE LONGEST AUTHORED DESCRIPTION -- 158 OF PRODUCTION'S 160 CHARACTERS -- UNFOLDS IN FULL
MOUSE WHEEL -- SCROLLS BY HAND; THE OPEN CARD STAYS OPEN AND SLIDES UNDER THE DRAWER'S EDGE
